constants.title: NIST 2022 CODATA constants: exact SI h, c and elementary charge

wavelength_convention: vacuum Ritz estimate from rounded NIST level differences; individual fine-structure components, not blended line centroids
uncertainty: No uncertainty inferred from printed decimals. Educational display rounded to 0.01 nm and 0.001 eV; not for precision calibration.
assumptions: Schematic level spacing, electron marker and photon path are not spatial orbit trajectories or physical timescales.
Allowed electric-dipole examples: parity changes, Δl = ±1 and ΔJ = 0, ±1 (0 → 0 excluded).
Illustrative spectrum shape, line width and height do not predict intensity, equivalent width or stellar populations.
